summary: The glucose data indicates generally good control with some hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia events. The current AAPS profile and settings are mostly appropriate but require some adjustments for better glucose management.

analysis_steps.findings: Good CGM coverage with minor gaps.
analysis_steps.evidence: CGM coverage is 98.7% with 10 gaps, the largest being 65 minutes.

analysis_steps.findings: Generally safe with some hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia.
analysis_steps.evidence: TIR is 86%, TAR is 8.9%, and TBR is 5.1%.

analysis_steps.findings: Basal rates and targets seem reasonable.
analysis_steps.evidence: Basal rates vary from 0.5 to 0.8 U/h. Targets are generally between 90-100 mg/dL.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Limited data on meal and correction boluses.

analysis_steps.findings: CR and ISF settings seem generally appropriate.
analysis_steps.evidence: CR varies from 10.5 to 13.2 g/U. ISF is 56 mg/dL/U. DIA is 10 hours.

analysis_steps.findings: SMB and UAM are enabled and frequently active.
analysis_steps.evidence: SMB is always enabled with UAM. SMB interval is 3 minutes.

analysis_steps.findings: Dynamic ISF is enabled. High max IOB and max basal rates are set.
analysis_steps.evidence: Autosens is disabled, but Dynamic ISF is enabled with a 70% adjustment factor. Max basal is 12 U/h, and max IOB is 25 U.

analysis_steps.findings: No clear meal bolus strategy due to lack of carb entries.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Lack of carb_treatment_entries and explicit meal bolus strategy details.

analysis_steps.evidence: No e-carb entries or extended boluses.

analysis_steps.findings: Recommend adjustments to max IOB and review meal strategy.
analysis_steps.evidence: High max IOB could lead to excessive insulin dosing. Lack of meal data limits understanding of meal strategy.

recommendations.title: Reduce max IOB
recommendations.description: High max IOB could lead to excessive insulin dosing.

recommendations.title: Review meal strategy
recommendations.description: Lack of meal data limits understanding of meal strategy.
recommendations.suggested_change: Record meal data including carb amounts and bolus timing.

profile_recommendation.recommendation: Keep basal rates with next verification after meal data review.
profile_recommendation.rationale: Basal rates seem reasonable based on available data.
profile_recommendation.next_check: Review basal rates after obtaining detailed meal data.

parameter_decisions.parameter: AAPS / max basal and max IOB limits
parameter_decisions.rationale: High max IOB could lead to excessive insulin dosing.

meal_strategy_summary.suggestion: Rely on SMB/UAM with frequent correction boluses. Review meal strategy with detailed meal data.
meal_strategy_summary.rationale: Frequent SMB activity and correction boluses. Lack of meal data.

implementation_steps: Record detailed meal data for further review.
education: Monitor glucose closely after changing max IOB.
Importance of recording meal data for accurate analysis.
safety_notes: High max IOB setting could lead to hypoglycemia.
